# Origin AI — Complete Site Content

> Origin AI is an Indian AI research lab founded in 2025, building safe general-purpose intelligence (AGI) and foundational AI models. Based in India, Origin AI competes directly with the world's most ambitious AI labs to advance India's leadership in the global AI race.

---

## Homepage

### Origin AI — Research and products that advance intelligence at the frontier

**Pioneering the future of AI**

AI will transform every industry and every aspect of human life. Origin AI is dedicated to developing the next generation of intelligent systems while ensuring their benefits are widely accessible.

Supported by Sarvam AI.

---

## About Origin AI

### Origin AI: Building the future of intelligence

#### Our Mission

The race to AGI will define human progress, and Origin AI exists to ensure India leads this frontier rather than follows it. We are building safe, general-purpose intelligence and foundational models to transform industries and push the boundaries of what is possible, competing directly with the world's most ambitious labs.

**Research**: Advancing foundational AI research in machine learning, NLP, and computer vision.

**Safety**: Developing AI systems that are aligned, transparent, and beneficial to humanity.

**Impact**: Making cutting-edge AI accessible and driving India's leadership in the global AI race.

#### Founding Team

- **Megha Surya Bodepudi** — Co-Founder. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/megha-surya-bodepudi-2b292b316/
- **Mahesh Bodepudi** — Co-Founder. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/maheshbodepudi/

## Careers at Origin AI

### Join the mission to shape intelligence

We are assembling a world-class team of researchers, engineers, and builders who share our conviction that transformative AI can — and should — be built from India. Origin AI is not just another startup; it is a bet on India's ability to compete at the highest level of AI research.

While we are currently operating in stealth and building our core team, we are always looking for exceptional people. If you believe in our mission and want to be part of something ambitious, we want to hear from you.

## News

### Origin AI selected for the Sarvam AI Startup Program

**Published**: August 2026 | **Category**: Partnership

We're excited to announce that Origin AI has been selected for the Sarvam AI Startup Program — an initiative designed to support early-stage companies building AI-powered products on India's sovereign AI infrastructure.

Sarvam AI is building full-stack AI infrastructure from India — including large language models, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and document intelligence APIs — all natively optimized for 22 Indian languages and English. Their mission to build sovereign, world-class AI from India deeply resonates with our own vision at Origin AI.

#### What this means for us

As part of the program, Origin AI receives:

- **API credits** — 6 to 12 months of access to Sarvam's production-grade APIs, including speech, language, and document intelligence endpoints.
- **Priority engineering support** — Direct access to Sarvam's engineering team for integration, optimization, and scaling guidance.
- **Production-ready infrastructure** — Enterprise-grade AI infrastructure built for reliability and scale, purpose-built for the Indian context.
- **Launch visibility** — Opportunities for co-branded case studies and ecosystem amplification.

#### Why this matters

At Origin AI, we believe the next wave of transformative AI will be built by teams who understand local context deeply. Sarvam's sovereign AI stack — trained on Indian languages and optimized for Indian use cases — gives us infrastructure that aligns with the problems we're solving.

This partnership accelerates our ability to build intelligent systems that are not just technically advanced, but genuinely accessible to the people they serve.

#### Looking ahead

Being part of the Sarvam Startup Program is a meaningful milestone for Origin AI. It validates our direction and gives us the tools to move faster. We're grateful to the Sarvam team for their support and look forward to building together.

Learn more about the Sarvam AI Startup Program: https://www.sarvam.ai/startup-program
